Build an animated capybara riding a hoverboard using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Deliver a single self-contained HTML file with all CSS and JavaScript inline. Do not use external libraries, external image assets, external fonts, or network requests. Inline SVG, CSS drawing, and canvas are allowed.

The result should visibly show a capybara riding a hoverboard, with animation that makes the scene feel alive. Do not include audio.

Return only the HTML source, without explanations or Markdown code fences.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Capybara Hoverboard Ride</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; }
  body {
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #20213f;
    font-family: ui-rounded, "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif;
  }
  svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .float-rig {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: hover 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .capy-sway {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: 55% 100%;
    animation: sway 4.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .wheel-spin {
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: spin 8s linear infinite;
  }
  .glow-pulse { animation: pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .spark {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: twinkle var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite;
  }
  .leaf-one { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: leaf 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .leaf-two { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: leaf 6s ease-in-out -2s infinite; }
  @keyframes hover {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-.5deg); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-13px) rotate(.5deg); }
  }
  @keyframes sway {
    0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-.7deg); }
    50% { transform: rotate(.8deg); }
  }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: .6; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes twinkle {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px) scale(.6); }
    45%, 65% { opacity: .85; transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1); }
  }
  @keyframes leaf {
    0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-8deg); }
    50% { transform: rotate(9deg); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg viewBox="0 0 900 650" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
  <title id="title">A capybara riding a glowing hoverboard</title>
  <desc id="desc">A relaxed little capybara cruises through a dreamy twilight sky on a turquoise hoverboard.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2=".8" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2b9a4"/>
      <stop offset=".42" stop-color="#9c9ad0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#485b89"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow">
      <stop stop-color="#ffe8b4" stop-opacity=".65"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffe8b4" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="boardTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#8affeb"/>
      <stop offset=".45" stop-color="#2bd5d0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#118baf"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="boardSide" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#197ba5"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#183b67"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1=".15" y1="0" x2=".8" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#c98b58"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#a9663e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#82482f"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="furLight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#e3ad73"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#bd7c4e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wheel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop stop-color="#324d77"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#17284d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#101c3d"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="blur">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="12"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softGlow" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="900" height="650" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="716" cy="135" r="180" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>
  <circle cx="716" cy="135" r="44" fill="#ffebc3" opacity=".87"/>
  <circle cx="729" cy="124" r="39" fill="#dfb5b4" opacity=".55"/>
  <g fill="#fff2df" opacity=".55">
    <circle cx="119" cy="108" r="2"/><circle cx="198" cy="184" r="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="92" r="2"/><circle cx="818" cy="239" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="279" r="1.8"/><circle cx="785" cy="72" r="1.7"/>
    <path d="M263 150v12m-6-6h12M785 302v10m-5-5h10"/>
  </g>
  <g id="particles"></g>

  <g opacity=".45" fill="#636d9e">
    <path d="M0 366l88-75 58 43 79-95 95 122 83-75 89 82 87-111 86 91 90-70 145 92v97H0z"/>
  </g>
  <g opacity=".46" fill="#465a87">
    <path d="M0 417l108-63 69 44 94-82 105 91 81-53 105 83 103-98 87 61 71-38 77 52v105H0z"/>
  </g>
  <path d="M0 442c119-32 188-14 285 9 117 28 217-24 337-5 102 16 171 12 278-16v220H0z" fill="#344a72"/>
  <path d="M0 488c138-31 254 8 364 2 122-7 228-47 340-21 79 18 136 12 196-4v185H0z" fill="#293f66"/>

  <g fill="none" stroke="#a3b7cb" stroke-width="2" opacity=".42">
    <path d="M106 377c22-10 49-10 72 0"/><path d="M715 414c24-12 51-12 76 0"/>
    <path d="M176 429c16-7 35-7 51 0"/><path d="M792 365c16-7 35-7 51 0"/>
  </g>

  <g class="leaf-one" transform="translate(115 468)">
    <path d="M0 18c3-24 18-38 42-42-2 25-16 40-42 42z" fill="#83c5a4" opacity=".78"/>
    <path d="M1 17L31-13" stroke="#d0e5b9" stroke-width="2" opacity=".7"/>
  </g>
  <g class="leaf-two" transform="translate(780 475) scale(.8)">
    <path d="M0 18c3-24 18-38 42-42-2 25-16 40-42 42z" fill="#83c5a4" opacity=".78"/>
    <path d="M1 17L31-13" stroke="#d0e5b9" stroke-width="2" opacity=".7"/>
  </g>

  <ellipse cx="459" cy="548" rx="202" ry="18" fill="#18294f" opacity=".46" filter="url(#blur)"/>
  <ellipse cx="459" cy="544" rx="154" ry="10" fill="#a6fff0" opacity=".23" class="glow-pulse"/>

  <g class="float-rig">
    <!-- Hoverboard wheels -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="354" cy="495" r="39" fill="url(#wheel)" stroke="#436c91" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="354" cy="495" r="27" fill="none" stroke="#46dfdc" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8"/>
      <circle cx="354" cy="495" r="17" fill="#243d66" stroke="#91fff0" stroke-width="3" class="glow-pulse"/>
      <g class="wheel-spin" stroke="#a7fff0" stroke-width="2" opacity=".72">
        <path d="M354 470v10M354 510v10M329 495h10M369 495h10"/>
        <path d="M336 477l7 7M365 506l7 7M372 477l-7 7M343 506l-7 7"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="573" cy="495" r="39" fill="url(#wheel)" stroke="#436c91" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="573" cy="495" r="27" fill="none" stroke="#46dfdc" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8"/>
      <circle cx="573" cy="495" r="17" fill="#243d66" stroke="#91fff0" stroke-width="3" class="glow-pulse"/>
      <g class="wheel-spin" stroke="#a7fff0" stroke-width="2" opacity=".72">
        <path d="M573 470v10M573 510v10M548 495h10M588 495h10"/>
        <path d="M555 477l7 7M584 506l7 7M591 477l-7 7M562 506l-7 7"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Board deck -->
    <path d="M287 451q0-10 14-10h315q14 0 14 10v12q0 9-13 14l-30 10H330l-29-10q-14-5-14-14z" fill="url(#boardSide)" stroke="#193b62" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M286 446q0-11 15-11h315q15 0 15 11t-15 11H301q-15 0-15-11z" fill="url(#boardTop)" stroke="#9affec" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M319 446h253" stroke="#e2fff1" stroke-width="2" opacity=".7"/>
    <path d="M304 462q151 16 310 0" fill="none" stroke="#60fff0" stroke-width="3" opacity=".8" filter="url(#softGlow)"/>
    <g fill="#173d63" opacity=".8">
      <circle cx="322" cy="446" r="3"/><circle cx="595" cy="446" r="3"/>
    </g>
    <text x="449" y="469" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="3" fill="#c9fff1">GLIDE</text>

    <g class="capy-sway">
      <!-- Far legs -->
      <path d="M378 365q18-7 29 5l-1 69q-1 9-13 9h-7q-11-1-10-11z" fill="#935636"/>
      <path d="M477 368q17-8 29 4l-1 67q-1 9-13 9h-7q-11-1-10-11z" fill="#935636"/>
      <!-- Near legs -->
      <path d="M412 371q18-6 29 6l-1 64q-1 9-13 9h-7q-11-1-10-11z" fill="url(#fur)"/>
      <path d="M514 367q18-7 29 5l-1 69q-1 9-13 9h-7q-11-1-10-11z" fill="url(#fur)"/>
      <path d="M378 437q11 4 27 0l-1 8q-1 6-12 6h-7q-9-1-8-8zM412 437q12 4 29 0l-1 8q-1 6-13 6h-7q-9-1-8-8zM477 436q12 4 29 0l-1 8q-1 6-13 6h-7q-9-1-8-8zM514 436q12 4 29 0l-1 8q-1 6-13 6h-7q-9-1-8-8z" fill="#75432f"/>
      <!-- Body -->
      <path d="M360 367c-15-18-17-48-2-73 17-29 50-43 91-40 38 3 66 23 76 51 8 23 2 49-10 71-8 21-25 35-51 38l-79-2c-20-1-32-17-25-45z" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#8c5238" stroke-width="2"/>
      <path d="M379 302c20-24 53-33 83-25 20 5 36 16 44 32-21-10-39-12-62-8-23 4-43 12-67 23-5-7-4-15 2-22z" fill="#dfa36b" opacity=".55"/>
      <path d="M367 358c13 14 30 20 48 19" fill="none" stroke="#e0a06c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".5"/>

      <!-- Head and neck -->
      <path d="M482 303c1-25 17-46 42-51 25-5 47 10 56 34l12 42c18 4 34 14 39 27 6 15-6 27-23 27l-25-5c-8 21-25 32-48 30-24-2-41-18-44-41l-20-24z" fill="url(#furLight)" stroke="#955b3a" stroke-width="2"/>
      <path d="M544 344c18-10 41-11 62-2 12 5 20 13 20 20 0 10-12 16-28 15l-23-5c-10 8-25 10-39 4-10-5-15-14-12-22 3-5 10-8 20-10z" fill="#d9a16c"/>
      <!-- Ear -->
      <ellipse cx="521" cy="264" rx="12" ry="15" transform="rotate(-23 521 264)" fill="#8a4c35"/>
      <ellipse cx="522" cy="264" rx="6" ry="8" transform="rotate(-23 522 264)" fill="#d98a70"/>
      <!-- Eye, nose and smile -->
      <ellipse cx="568" cy="309" rx="5.5" ry="7" fill="#2c1e20"/>
      <circle cx="570" cy="307" r="1.8" fill="#fff2d5"/>
      <ellipse cx="627" cy="358" rx="10" ry="7" transform="rotate(-13 627 358)" fill="#39252b"/>
      <circle cx="630" cy="356" r="2" fill="#70504a"/>
      <path d="M606 374q-10 7-20 0" fill="none" stroke="#754431" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <!-- Tiny fur tufts -->
      <path d="M501 267l-5-9 10 5 2-11 6 10M532 254l-1-9 7 8 5-8 2 10" fill="none" stroke="#a86643" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M546 329q8-4 17-2" fill="none" stroke="#f1c18a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".7"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Soft light under the board -->
    <path d="M321 500q128 28 286 0" fill="none" stroke="#59fff0" stroke-width="4" opacity=".42" filter="url(#softGlow)"/>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(63 54)">
    <rect width="142" height="38" rx="19" fill="#29375f" opacity=".52" stroke="#d5fff0" stroke-opacity=".4"/>
    <circle cx="21" cy="19" r="5" fill="#7affdf" class="glow-pulse"/>
    <text x="37" y="23" fill="#f4f6ed" font-size="11" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2">HOVER MODE</text>
  </g>
  <text x="837" y="605" text-anchor="end" fill="#d6e9e8" opacity=".56" font-size="11" letter-spacing="3">TWILIGHT CRUISE</text>
</svg>
<script>
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const particles = document.getElementById("particles");
  for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
    const dot = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
    dot.setAttribute("class", "spark");
    dot.setAttribute("cx", 28 + Math.random() * 844);
    dot.setAttribute("cy", 35 + Math.random() * 385);
    dot.setAttribute("r", (1 + Math.random() * 2).toFixed(1));
    dot.setAttribute("fill", i % 3 === 0 ? "#b5fff0" : "#fff4dc");
    dot.style.setProperty("--delay", `${(-Math.random() * 5).toFixed(2)}s`);
    dot.style.setProperty("--duration", `${(2.8 + Math.random() * 3.8).toFixed(2)}s`);
    particles.appendChild(dot);
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
